step1.description:
Tanner Linsley is the creator of a multitude of open source libraries for the React ecosystem. The past couple years he's brought those tools to every JavaScript framework. So I figured it'd be a good time to bring him on and talk about what he's been doing and where he sees the future of the web heading.
